title: Second moment of the correlated sign projection
statement: For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and every vector $t=(t_1,t_2)$ in the real two-dimensional correlation plane, the expected square of $X t_1+Y t_2$ under the correlated sign-pair law with parameter $\rho$ is $t_1^2+2\rho t_1t_2+t_2^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ belongs to the real two-dimensional correlation plane
